headline: NEWS Giants star Burns suffered torn ACL in win over Titans, out for rest of '26 The Giants have suffered another major injury early in the 2026 season. Star pass rusher Brian Burns is believed to have suffered a torn ACL in Sunday’s win over Tennessee. Sep 28, 2026

NEWS Dolphins RB Achane to miss rest of '26 season after tearing ACL in loss Dolphins RB De'Von Achane will miss the remainder of the 2026 season after suffering a torn ACL in Sunday's loss to the Chiefs, NFL Network and ESPN reported. Sep 28, 2026
